_**User**_

Write a script which save the prediction comparision between file1 and file2 into scripts/PredictionComparison/tchibo/20260918

file1: s3://innkeepr-development/targeting.history/20260918/68b69dff2e5f2d9a58cce692_2026-09-18 10:01:50.363494_tchibo_embedded.parquet, refer to as embedded

1. download the data
2. check via treatment column wich is control and which one is treatment
3. count users for each file, compare difference between the file
4. control-group-uses: check if they are the same between both files, and if not, how many difference is in them (totals and percentage)
5. do step 4 for treatment-group as well

Save analyze to a csv file
Log output into the above path as well.
